plugin.name: Confirm Prerequisites (Read Description)
plugin.description:
Please verify that the following required mods are installed and active in your profile:
* Hideout Furniture Mod (Base) [Version 2.3.2] (Provides core workbench and placing engine) * Hideout Gadgets for Hideout Furniture [Version 0.7.2] (Provides alarms, turrets, and defense ratings) * Hideout Furniture Expansion [Version 1.0.2] (Provides beds, stoves, and furniture varieties) * Even More Hideout Furniture [Version 2.2] (Provides pianos, radios, fridges, and decor)
Without these base mods active, you will experience missing section crashes when decorations spawn or when using workbenches. Click Next to proceed.

plugin.name: Modern Vanilla (Default & Recommended)
plugin.description: The definitive v1.2.0 theme. Blends the clean vanilla PDA layout and high-readability typography with restored tactical colored module borders, cards, headers, and status alert banners.

plugin.name: Vanilla
plugin.description: The flat vanilla reskin. Uses standard Anomaly UI elements, dark transparent boxes, and vanilla PDA button styling.

plugin.name: Modern
plugin.description: The legacy modern theme from v1.1.8. Features dark textured cards, neon accent borders, custom tactical buttons, and modern typography.

plugin.name: No PDA Tab
plugin.description: Disables remote PDA interface. You will manage your settlements and reassign survivor jobs in-person at your Settlement Camp Hub (workbench).

plugin.name: Standard S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Anomaly
plugin.description: Select this if you are playing standard Anomaly. No G.A.M.M.A. patches will be installed. On G.A.M.M.A. this option stops the game at startup with a duplicate [alarm_system] section: pick the G.A.M.M.A. pack instead.

plugin.name: G.A.M.M.A. Compatibility Pack (All Patches)
plugin.description: Select this if you are playing S.T.A.L.K.E.R. G.A.M.M.A. This installs all G.A.M.M.A. patches: enforces G.A.M.M.A.'s stash balancing/loot logic for camp chests, rebalances alarm system recipes, and integrates the Automatic Gun Turret addon.
